turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I've got a whole free Saturday to study and I can't decide how to use it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me get through all the options before you weigh in.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I could spend the morning on chemistry past papers and the afternoon reviewing what I got wrong.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another idea is to go to the library with my friend and work alongside her all day.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or split the day into four short blocks with a different subject in each and long breaks.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's the full list. Go ahead.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The past paper plan is the most effective if chemistry is your weakest subject, since mistakes are where the learning is. The library with your friend helps motivation, but only if you actually work. The four blocks are great for keeping everything ticking over.
